blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 SINGAPORE–Alex Eala has landed in Japan for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Eala arrived at Chubu Centrair International Airport from Singapore on Saturday and was welcomed by Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) chief Bambol Tolentino. The World No. 18 is one of the Philippines’ top gold-medal bets and brightest stars in the continental showcase.
